findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_filings, chart, screen, get_code_example, try_sample · Private data: search_filings, cite_this, read_primary_text, chart, query_regime, get_code_example, get_backtest, list_backtests, approve_action, risk_assess, agent_activity · Public sink: query_dataset, screen, run_backtest, set_price_alert · Destructive: explain_provenance, get_inclusion_proof, cite_this, run_recipe, run_backtest, replay_backtest, list_backtests, memory_replay_query, run_research, get_research, approve_action, delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_filings, chart, screen, get_code_example, try_sample · Private data: search_filings, cite_this, read_primary_text, chart, query_regime, get_code_example, get_backtest, list_backtests, approve_action, risk_assess, agent_activity · Public sink: query_dataset, screen, run_backtest, set_price_alert · Destructive: explain_provenance, get_inclusion_proof, cite_this, run_recipe, run_backtest, replay_backtest, list_backtests, memory_replay_query, run_research, get_research, approve_action, delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_filings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
